description: Fixed-form program text that begins its line in AREA A (character positions 8-11) but is not an area-A item or a level-number: a statement, a sentence, an entry or clause continued on a subsequent line, a separator period, and ANY text of a CONTINUATION line (a hyphen in the indicator area: 'Area A of a continuation line must be blank'). ANSI X3.23-1985's reference format wrote everything but the area-A items in area B (position 12 to margin R) - an entry, sentence, statement or clause continued 'by starting subsequent line(s) in area B'; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 removed the areas, and the 2023 rule continues an entry 'by starting subsequent COBOL words, literals, or picture character-strings in the program-text area of a subsequent line' (ISO §2023:6.3.5). Level-numbers other than 01 and 77 may begin in either area (indentation by level). Refused at COBOL-85 by the ONE AreaPlacementPass (kb/Work PB3147) for the text that begins a token, and by the §2023:6.5 logical conversion (ReferenceFormatDiagnostics.OnContinuationTextInAreaA, kb/Work PB3168) for a continuation line, whose tail of a continued literal is no token's start; the edge is DERIVED, not quoted (VCR row 7.35), with the same evidence as fixed-form-area-a-item-outside-area-a-2002.
display: program text other than an area-A item or a level-number that begins its fixed-form line in area A
citation: ANSI X3.23-1985 reference format, area B; ISO §2023:6.3.1, §2023:6.3.5: no areas from 2002
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.35 - areas A and B of the fixed-form program-text area, removed in 2002
